_comment: Per-example overrides for fingerprint tolerance and accepted-status. Defaults in generate_fingerprint.py: best_loss abs=1e-6 rel=1e-3; component abs=1e-6 rel=5e-3; hyperparam abs=1e-3 rel=1e-3; evals_tol=0. Override only when justified.

05_extra_observables.tolerance_rationale: Best loss, components and RCUT2B are pinned at the default tolerances. The evaluation count is not deterministic across machines: the optimum is on the clamped bound RCUT2B = 6.0, and whether DLIB:BFGS's line search accepts a re-evaluation there depends on the sign of a ~1e-13 relative, rounding-level drift of the warm-started lattice relaxation. The run stops after 16-17 evaluations or runs to MAXEVAL = 30 (the reference machine), and a 1-ulp change of the hot_a0 start or of one training energy flips it; evals_tol 14 accepts 16..44.

06_init_random.description: INIT { STRATEGY RANDOM, SEED, INCLUDE_CONFIG false }.

09_init_warm.description: INIT { STRATEGY WARM } from a bootstrapped seed_pot.tadah.

12_prestage.description: STRATEGY PRESTAGE; NLOPT:GN_CRS2_LM explore + DLIB:BFGS refine.

status_accepted: STOPPED -- stagnation: no new best in 3 evals after 2 restart(s)
13_restart.tolerance_rationale: RESTART RANDOM seeds each restart from std::random_device, so the restart evaluations differ from run to run. Only values that do not depend on them are pinned: the best comes from the deterministic first launch, and each restart stops after exactly AFTER_STAGNATION evaluations because no start in the box beats the incumbent (see evaluations.note).

15_simulated_annealing.description: TADAH:ANNEAL classic with seed-local auto-T0 calibration (post T_HOT rename).

16_fixweight_mixed.description: NLOPT:LN_BOBYQA over a flat OPTIM FIXWEIGHT(14); mixed LS-fit + pinned + OPTIM'd weights.
16_fixweight_mixed.tolerance_rationale: Weight 14 multiplies a descriptor that is zero on this dataset, so the loss does not depend on it: every evaluation ties up to ~2e-13 relative, the rounding-level noise of the warm-started lattice relaxation (exact Ecoh.in read-back), and that noise decides which evaluation is the best (weight 0, -25 or +25). The loss and components are pinned at the default tolerances; FIXWEIGHT[14] is checked only for presence: abs_tol 100 (the box width) accepts any value in its box [-50, 50].
